Figure 1: Overview of PUPPET . For each input query q ∈ Q, PUPPET samples k responses from the base model π, scores each with a detector score SDet and an evaluator score SEval, assign “chosen” and “rejected” based on the combined score S, and fine-tunes π via DPO.

Figure 7: Reward ablation (Qwen3). Bar labels: point-wise changes from Vanilla. ROUGE-L (left) and Judge (right) task axes are proportionally scaled.
